node_definition.done_when: Per §36 of the plan: first reproduce both refusals at the base revision (a plan review promoted with --gate not-run and no --outcome refused 'no head-keyed record path'; a queue-launched run review refused 'a non-passing gate requires --outcome'), naming in the manifest why _resolve_promotion_outcome reads each as it does, with the responsible lines read from the committed blob. Then a plan review's default outcome names its finding count and the count that would change the plan; a plan review whose report carries no RUBRIC or FINDING line is refused naming the report, and one the store cannot parse is refused naming the store's reason; a queue-launched run review composes its outcome from its stored record; a run review that declares no head-keyed record path is still refused as now. A test in a temporary home covers each case. Every test file importing reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py or reckon/crew/recovery_review_delivery.py, rebuilt from the head tree, adds no failure against a base arm, both arms from git checkouts under the run's own scratch directory with RECKON_SESSION_HOST_SETTLE, RECKON_FOLLOWER_OWNER, RECKON_FOLLOWER_IMAGE_COMMIT and RECKON_FOLLOWER_SOURCE_ROOT unset, run in place on the fleet node with pytest -n 8. Every log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT=. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the changed files, judged against the base blobs. If the queue-launched case needs a module outside the write paths, stop with status blocked naming it.
